text: House File 2673 H-8150 Amend House File 2673 as follows: 1 1. Page 1, after line 26 by inserting: 2 < Sec. ___. NEW SECTION . 321.515A Civil liability —— 3 exceptions. 4 1. The owner of a driverless-capable vehicle is deemed to 5 be operating the vehicle while the automated driving system 6 is engaged and shall be liable for personal injury, death, or 7 property damage that results in connection with the operation 8 of the vehicle. 9 2. An owner’s liability under subsection 1 does not preclude 10 a person injured by a driverless-capable vehicle, while the 11 automated driving system was engaged, from bringing an action 12 against the manufacturer of the driverless-capable vehicle 13 and any person who installed the vehicle’s automated driving 14 system if the driverless-capable vehicle malfunctioned or if 15 the automated driving system malfunctioned. 16 3. Subsection 1 does not apply to a driverless-capable 17 vehicle owned by a college, university, or research facility if 18 the vehicle is operating for educational or research purposes. > 19 2.
